description: Encodes eight control voltages into the one signal an ESX-8CV expander decodes, taking the eight in rotation

inputs.text: Feeds the ESX-8CV output of the same number; the voltage is multiplied by 384 into a twelve-bit word, which clips it at about 5.33V either way

outputs.text: The encoded stream for the ESX-8CV; patch it to an input of an ES-5 Encoder or ES-4(0) Encoder

notes: The output is an encoded stream and not a voltage: patch it to an input of an ES-5 Encoder or ES-4(0) Encoder, and nothing reaches an ESX-8CV without that.
The ES-5 Encoder or ES-4(0) Encoder outputs in turn go to the audio interface channels wired to the hardware.
